tg-iraqipmoeng-24735.title: Iraq forms an inter-agency committee to address obstacles facing stalled and uninitiated investment projects
tg-iraqipmoeng-24735.summary: The PMO English channel said the committee will examine legal, technical and administrative obstacles affecting identified stalled or uninitiated investment projects. The public post did not list the projects.

tg-iraqipmoeng-24734.title: Iraq's prime minister chairs the fifth regular session of the High Commission for Coordination Among the Provinces
tg-iraqipmoeng-24734.summary: The PMO English channel announced the commission's fifth regular session. A follow-on post relevant to this briefing described a committee to address obstacles affecting stalled investment projects.

tg-inainaiq-158548.title: Communications minister says the Ooredoo marine-landing addendum will be signed in Doha next month
tg-inainaiq-158548.summary: INA relayed Mustafa Sanad's statement that the Ooredoo marine-landing contract addendum is planned for signature in Doha next month. It should be distinguished from the internet-transit contract signed on 10 September.

tg-inainaiq-158485.title: INA confirms Iraq and Ooredoo signed an internet-capacity transit contract to Europe
tg-inainaiq-158485.summary: The Iraqi News Agency channel confirmed that ITPC and Ooredoo signed a strategic transit contract to carry international internet capacity through Iraq toward Europe.

tg-mociraq2023-1699.title: Iraq's Ministry of Communications publishes the Ooredoo internet-transit signing ceremony
tg-mociraq2023-1699.summary: The official channel showed the signing and confirmed that Iraq's General Company for Communications and Informatics and Ooredoo are advancing international internet-capacity transit through Iraq between the Gulf and Europe.

tg-mociraq2023-1698.title: Iraq and Qatar's Ooredoo sign a Gulf-to-Europe internet-transit contract
tg-mociraq2023-1698.summary: Iraq's General Company for Communications and Informatics and Ooredoo signed a strategic agreement to carry international internet capacity across Iraq, targeting a short and secure Gulf-to-Europe data corridor.

tg-iraqcmc-10972.title: Iraq CMC unveils a plan for national artificial-intelligence infrastructure
tg-iraqcmc-10972.summary: CMC's chief executive met the prime minister's adviser for artificial intelligence to discuss specialised national infrastructure for AI applications, advanced data processing and domestic technical capability.

tg-mociraq2023-1697.title: Iraq plans to extend its secure government LTE network to all public institutions
tg-mociraq2023-1697.summary: Communications Minister Mustafa Sanad and Taurus Arm discussed expanding the secure government LTE network and using 5G technology to improve speed, performance, digital-government capacity and service security.

tg-modiraq-13018.title: Iraq's Defence Ministry reviews the officers' housing programme
tg-modiraq-13018.summary: The ministry's secretary-general reviewed land allocation, housing for families of fallen and wounded personnel, retirees and participating officers, as well as obstacles delaying procedures.

tg-iraqcmc-10968.title: Iraq CMC advances local mail services and reviews fake-SIM and drone rules
tg-iraqcmc-10968.summary: CMC's chief executive chaired a management meeting covering regulatory and technical projects, including delayed Starlink deliveries, a local mail service, fake-SIM controls and drone-related rules.

tg-iqmofa-15158.title: Iraq's foreign minister meets Qatar's minister of state during the Arab League meeting
tg-iqmofa-15158.summary: Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein met Qatar's Minister of State Sultan bin Saad Al Muraikhi in Cairo to discuss bilateral relations and broader cooperation.

tg-mociraq2023-1696.title: Iraq's Communications Ministry discusses digital and financial cooperation with the Al-Abbas Shrine
tg-mociraq2023-1696.summary: Minister Mustafa Sanad and an Al-Abbas Shrine delegation explored cooperation in digital, electronic and financial services to improve service delivery and expand digital transformation.

tg-iraqcmc-10950.title: Iraq CMC and the cultural mission in Bucharest discuss ICT talent development
tg-iraqcmc-10950.summary: A CMC delegation discussed using Romanian universities and research institutions to develop Iraqi telecommunications and information-technology talent and academic cooperation.

tg-iqmofa-15135.title: Iraq's deputy foreign minister meets the Chinese ambassador in Baghdad
tg-iqmofa-15135.summary: The two sides discussed stronger political, economic and cultural cooperation and agreed to advance a new round of political consultations and bilateral committee work.

tg-iraqcmc-10947.title: Iraq CMC delegation visits the Iraqi embassy in Romania
tg-iraqcmc-10947.summary: During the international satellite-spectrum monitoring meeting in Bucharest, the delegation discussed regulatory exchanges, spectrum cooperation and support for Iraqi participation.

tg-iraqcmc-10944.title: Iraq CMC and Romania's ANCOM deepen digital-regulation cooperation
tg-iraqcmc-10944.summary: The regulators discussed cooperation in digital transformation, communications infrastructure, spectrum management and monitoring, 5G, artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.

tg-iraqcmc-10941.title: Iraq CMC joins the international satellite-spectrum monitoring meeting in Romania
tg-iraqcmc-10941.summary: CMC exchanged practices on satellite-spectrum monitoring technology and regulation with national regulators, the ITU, industry experts and international companies.

tg-iraqcmc-10939.title: Iraq CMC expands Korek closures to Kirkuk, Nineveh and Salah al-Din
tg-iraqcmc-10939.summary: CMC and the National Security Service closed Korek Telecom offices and service locations in three provinces, extending earlier enforcement in Baghdad, Karbala, Najaf, Diwaniyah, Babil and other areas.

tg-moiiraqi-73000.title: Iraqi police arrest two suspects over celebratory gunfire in Mosul
tg-moiiraqi-73000.summary: Nineveh's anti-crime department and the National Security Service identified the suspects from a public video, seized the weapons and initiated legal measures under Decision No. 570 of 1982.

tg-moiiraqi-72988.title: Iraq's Interior Ministry warns against unlawful AI-generated indecent content
tg-moiiraqi-72988.summary: The ministry said it is monitoring AI-generated videos that violate public-decency standards, warned of strict penalties coordinated with the judiciary and asked the public to report offending accounts.

tg-iraqcmc-10931.title: Iraq CMC chief joins a high-level Arab forum on digital transformation and AI in Doha
tg-iraqcmc-10931.summary: The UNDP, Ooredoo Group and Doha Institute forum focused on building inclusive and sustainable digital economies and shaping digital and AI policy across the Arab region.

tg-iraqcmc-10927.title: Iraq CMC chief meets Iraq's ambassador to Qatar in Doha
tg-iraqcmc-10927.summary: The meeting took place alongside a regional forum on digital policy and artificial intelligence and covered Iraq's participation in regional digital-policy cooperation.

tg-mociraq2023-1695.title: Iraq plans a 40% government internet price cut and a 40% rise in tower speeds
tg-mociraq2023-1695.summary: The communications minister directed a 40% price reduction for government internet at unchanged capacity and a 40% speed increase for tower-based users outside fibre coverage, subject to ministry approval.

tg-iqmofa-15126.title: Iraq reviews regional developments and preparations for the prime minister's foreign visits
tg-iqmofa-15126.summary: The discussions covered domestic political activity, planned prime-ministerial travel, relations with Gulf and neighbouring states, and regional coordination following the US-Iran war.

tg-iraqcmc-10925.title: Iraq CMC closes Korek service locations in Najaf, Diwaniyah and Babil
tg-iraqcmc-10925.summary: CMC and the National Security Service closed multiple Korek offices and service centres across three provinces, including the company's location at Najaf International Airport.

tg-iqmofa-15121.title: Fourth Arab SME Summit to take place in Baghdad in November
tg-iqmofa-15121.summary: The 18–20 November 2026 summit, organised by ESCWA and Iraq's Planning Ministry, will cover finance, market access, digital transformation, artificial intelligence and entrepreneurial cooperation.

tg-iraqcmc-10918.title: Iraq CMC shuts down four unlicensed digital television networks in Basra
tg-iraqcmc-10918.summary: CMC, the National Security Service and supporting security bodies stopped four unlicensed networks and said unlicensed digital television broadcasting in the province had been fully terminated.

tg-mociraq2023-1692.title: Baghdad to host the fourth Arab SME Summit
tg-mociraq2023-1692.summary: The 18–20 November 2026 event will address SME and start-up finance, market access, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, partnerships and growth opportunities.

tg-iraqcmc-10914.title: Iraq CMC closes Korek's headquarters in Karbala
tg-iraqcmc-10914.summary: CMC's Karbala office, working with national security and intelligence bodies, closed Korek Telecom's local headquarters as part of ongoing regulatory enforcement.

tg-iraqcmc-10911.title: Iraq CMC ends paper-based licence applications
tg-iraqcmc-10911.summary: From 1 September 2026, individuals, companies and institutions must submit all CMC licence applications through the commission's electronic-services portal.

tg-iraqcmc-10910.title: Iraq CMC chief outlines the security annex to Starlink's licence
tg-iraqcmc-10910.summary: CMC chief executive Baligh Abu Kalal explained the security provisions attached to Starlink's licensing arrangements in Iraq.

tg-mociraq2023-1686.title: Iraq's communications minister and China's ambassador discuss telecoms and postal cooperation
tg-mociraq2023-1686.summary: The two sides discussed digital infrastructure and service upgrades. China invited Iraq to join international digital-economy and green-development cooperation and the Digital Silk Road.

tg-iraqcmc-10909.title: Iraq CMC reviews the draft cybercrime law and other regulatory matters
tg-iraqcmc-10909.summary: CMC's board discussed the draft cybercrime law submitted by parliament's Security and Defence Committee and provided views on related regulatory and technical issues.
